Title: Public Preview: Azure Site Recovery Support for Azure Trusted Launch VMs Running Linux OS

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Trusted Launch VMs running Linux OS is in public preview. Azure Trusted Launch VMs provide foundational compute security to Azure Generation 2 VMs by enabling Secure Boot and vTPM capabilities. This public preview is available for Azure Trusted launch VMs running Linux OS. Azure Site Recovery support for Trusted launch VM running Windows OS is already generally available. 


Learn more.
